Prayer in Wa Sr No.126345 of 2025: Appeal filed under Clause 15 of
 Letters Patent to set aside the order dated 18.2.2025 passed by the
learned
Single Judge
in W.P.No.1279 of 2025.

For Petitioners/ Mr.K.Karthik Jagannath
 Appellants: Government Advocate
Judgment
(Made by the Hon'ble Chief Justice) Heard on application for condonation of delay.
The appeal is barred by a delay of 139 days.

The cause shown in the application is as below:
20.
I respectfully submit that there occurred a delay of 139 day in filing this writ appeal.
The delay is neither wilful nor wanton but due to the administrative exigencies and official procedures.
Unless the delay is condoned, the Appellants/Department/Government will be put to irreparable loss and hardship and much financial strain.
_ _ __ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
On the other hand, no prejudice would be caused to the Respondent if the delay is condoned and the Writ appeal is adjudicated on merits in the interests of Justice, equity and fair play.
2. We find that the objection which is being raised is that the application seeking enhancement was itself delayed.

The learned Single Judge has allowed the petition taking into consideration the Supreme Courts decision in the case of Narendra and others v. State of Uttar Pradesh and others1, which says that even where no applications are filed, in such cases if a particular compensation has been awarded to the other land owners under the same notification, the same should be extended to the person who is claiming compensation at the same rate.
